description: Move a run back to open so a step can be answered again, or abandon it when the job did not happen. A signed-off run is refused: a signature is the point at which a run stops moving.

date.description: The day the step happened, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

note.description: Why. Kept on the run's history and printed nowhere else

run.description: The run id, e.g. RUN-2026-0001, or its title when only one carries it

status.description: open puts a complete run back into edit; abandoned closes it without a signature

name: run_status
title: Reopen or abandon a run
